picks.headline: My agent army writes Code Connect | Dev Mindset
picks.excerpt: A Figma engineer runs a fleet of coding agents to generate Code Connect mappings, showing what it looks like to supervise agents instead of writing the glue code yourself.
picks.rationale: First-party Figma demo of the design-system-to-code handoff being done by a fleet of agents — the most directly copyable working method in today's pool.

picks.headline: Atomica introduces AI Thermal Microstructures Platform
picks.excerpt: Atomica launched a platform for AI-designed thermal microstructures, applying generative methods to the physical geometry of heat-management components.
picks.rationale: Backfills the fxguide slot: a shipped platform where generative geometry produces manufacturable hardware, not renders — the clearest AI-into-physical-design launch in the pool.

picks.headline: Why AI Websites All Look the Same and How to Build Something Different
picks.excerpt: A breakdown of why prompt-generated sites converge on the same gradient-and-card aesthetic, and the constraints, tokens and references that push AI output off the default.
picks.rationale: Names the homogenisation problem every designer hits with generative UI and gives concrete constraint/token levers to break the default look tomorrow.

picks.headline: OpenAI will pull its models from Cursor due to SpaceXAI acquisition
picks.excerpt: OpenAI plans to cut off Cursor's access to its models on November 12, 2026, forcing everyone who prototypes UI in Cursor onto a different model lineup.
picks.rationale: A hard date on the calendar: design engineers who prototype UI in Cursor have to re-plan their model lineup before November 12.

picks.headline: Build and deploy eve agents from the Vercel dashboard
picks.excerpt: Agents can now be created, configured and deployed directly from the Vercel dashboard, no local scaffolding required.
picks.rationale: Prompt-to-agent from a GUI drops the terminal requirement, putting agent building inside reach of designers who never scaffold projects locally.
